name: How do I choose a reliable contractor for stair repair?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a reliable contractor for stair repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor, look for experience, positive customer reviews, and transparent communication. Ensure they are licensed and insured. Ask for references and a detailed estimate. A reputable contractor will thoroughly assess the damage and provide clear explanations of the repair process and costs. Frasheski Construction meets these criteria.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a reliable contractor based on experience, reviews, licensing, insurance, and clear communication.
